description: This file defines the LoggerLevelRangeFilter class, which is a filter for logging events based on level ranges within the log4php logging framework. It includes configuration options for minimum and maximum log levels, as well as the behavior on match.

classes.name: LoggerLevelRangeFilter
classes.description: A filter class that accepts or rejects logging events based on whether their level falls within a specified range, with configurable acceptance behavior on match.

methods.name: getAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Returns whether the filter accepts matching levels.

methods.name: setAcceptOnMatch
methods.description: Sets whether the filter should accept events that fall within the level range.

methods.name: getLevelMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum level for filtering.

methods.name: setLevelMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level for filtering.

methods.name: getLevelMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum level for filtering.

methods.name: setLevelMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum log level for filtering.

methods.name: decide
methods.description: Decides whether to accept, deny, or remain neutral for a given logging event based on the level range and acceptance configuration.
